find: ? 'it has too few buttons or sticks for Tanks.'
replace: ? "Tanks can't read its buttons in this browser."
why: Issue #597. Every unsupported pad gets the unknown-mapping sentence, including one whose profile matched but which lacks the controls it needs. That player is told the browser cannot read the pad, when the real fix is a pad with more buttons or sticks. Killed by the insufficient-controls case. ANCHOR REPOINTED (issue #556): the controller label helpers moved from `createHud`'s closure to `src/game/controller-labels.ts`, taking the live pad list as a parameter instead of reading `currentDetectedPads` from scope. The mutation is unchanged in meaning; only where the line lives, and its indentation, moved.
killedBy: hud: controller assignment panel (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-17-controller-assignment.md) a pad the browser reports but Tanks cannot read (issue #597) says why in its own words when a profile matched but the pad lacks the controls
